hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.papercuts/papercuts.db"; if [ -f "$d" ]; then n=$(PAPERCUTS_STORE=local PAPERCUTS_DB="$d" papercuts list 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^count: \([0-9]*\) of.*/\1/p'); if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$n open papercuts of the review site (skill handling-review-papercuts)"; fi; fi; exit 0
